modeling_notes: YJ-18 range conflict (factor ~2.4): DoD A-tier gives 290 nm (537 km); ONI/Carlson/Janes B-tier gives ~120 nm (~220 km) as the lower end of a 220-540 km range band. Per OOB Arbitrated Corrections and authoring-standard preference ordering (A > B), this record's max_flight_time_s is derived from the DoD 537 km figure; the B-tier ~220 km alternate is noted here rather than modeled, per task instruction to 'document the YJ-18/CY-5 cell split' and note both range figures.

No functional mount exists for ASCMs (mechanism gap); content-only for _real_world.weapon_inventory on all VLS-equipped hulls (Type 052D/052DL, Type 055) and content-only for the SSN torpedo-tube-launched sub-variant (Type 093B).

YJ-18A is the improved variant (2019 parade, 2025-26 CCTV VLS test footage of a radar-absorbent-coated round); performance deltas vs baseline YJ-18 are not public, so this record uses the baseline YJ-18 parameter set per OOB (csg-cn-yj18-scmp-2026, B).
